name: Judy Ward
bio: Judy leads the newsroom from Augusta, Georgia. Her career spans more than fifteen years in editorial leadership at regional and national publications, with a background that includes reporting on politics, state government, and federal courts before she moved into editing. She sets the standards for what runs on the site, oversees the corrections record, and is the final authority on questions of what Herald News Today will and will not publish.
